notes.title: Regular Update v0.6.1 - Nov 24th 2024
notes.notes:
https://i.imgur.com/hFvUBbE.jpeg

Arcane Treasures: Trading Card Game has been updated to the latest version with the following changes:
The space previously occupied by "Early Access Rewards" on the right of the Main Menu is now used to promote actions to the player. It'll suggest you to play the tutorial, build a deck, open boosters when you have them etc. and give useful exposition
The Card Collection menu now allows you to search keywords to filter to cards of a faction or rarity by entering any of the following: Factionless, Arcana, Darkness, Fairy, Natura, Mecha, Rogue, Common, Uncommon, Rare, Ultra, Promo, C, U, R, U, PR
UR (Ultra Rare) cards from Booster Packs now contain texturing, setting them apart from standard R (Rare) cards in a way other than their appearance rate
A new challenge has been added, granting you a new card "Box of Fated Miracles" and 3 Booster Packs if you build a valid deck
The deck builder now actively tells you what you need to do to make your deck valid without exiting the deck builder and reading the invalid deck tooltip.
Improvements to AI:
 - Bots now make basic contextual decisions about which cards to play: They'll focus getting their hand size up when it's small, use turn-ending effects only if they don't have other cards they can play, only try to use "niche" Leader cards if the situation makes sense, etc.
  - Bots now select & discard cards based on the context of the game; e.g. if they have full character slots, they'll choose to discard cards like Megaphone, or using Time Gun with an empty hand they're much more likely to select a card draw Leader
  - Fixed a bug where bots could play Leader cards during some Treasure and Character effects, causing a soft-lock
When opening a booster pack, unowned cards display a small "New!" badge
When inspecting cards from a booster pack, the number you own will be displayed (like when inspecting cards in the Deck Builder)
If the game cannot connect to the remote services backend a message will be displayed to tell the user this.
 - While the backend is still in development, it does occasionally go down. This is being actively worked on, if it does go down you can flag this in the Discord and it will be restarted.
Cards in the card collection are now ordered alphabetically (rather than in set order)
Fixed an issue where cards viewed from the discard pile would be displayed below the discard pile list
Showcased cards on the front-most main menu can now be inspected

Many of the changes here are based on playtester feedback! Suggestions from users are discussed in the Discord server and reasonable adaptations & interpretations of feedback often result in changes in the game!

Next Priorities
The next priorities for the game will be based around:
Speeding up game time
Simplifying the core game flow
Making it easier to build a new deck
Decreasing the random chance associated with combat

To get involved in beta testing, submit the form found here.

notes.title: Major Update Release (v0.6)
notes.notes:
VERSION 0.6 (October 21st 2024)

Log in to receive 10 free booster packs of Arcane Treasures: Treasures Unveiled
https://i.imgur.com/OwdvTct.jpeg
Changes
 MAJOR: Chain Revealing has been removed.
 MAJOR: The tutorial has been redesigned entirely from scratch. It now guides the player through individually core actions over the course of multiple turns, and includes some extra information about using the game's controls/interface after feedback.
 If you felt like the previous tutorial didn't quite teach you well enough, I'd like to encourage you to try the new tutorial as well.
 MAJOR: Treasure Cards now feature one of four stat boosts:
ATK+: Your Characters in play get +1 Attack permanently
DEF+: Your Characters in play get +1 Defense permanently
 CHR+: You can put 1 more Character into play permanently
RDY+: Ready one more card at the beginning of your turn
These stats are displayed next to player information on the top and bottom of the left screen
You can only gain up to 3 pips in each stat (e.g. even if you have 7 ATK+ Treasure cards, you will only gain +3 Attack in this way)
 MAJOR: Fight effects can now only be used if the Character is either the Defending or Attacking Character
 MAJOR: Implemented functionality for recurring events. The first such event is the Ranked Challenge, where players can compete against each other to earn Ranked Points for prizes! Stay tuned for the first appearance of this event.
 MAJOR: Added a Rewards Pass, allowing players to earn greater rewards for playing the game. The intention is to have this paid for in the in-game store, but for now it can only be earned through gameplay. A new Rewards Pass would be added each time a card set is released.
 MAJOR: The first iteration of an in-game store has been added. It's currently very barebones while the limited development funds are directed into free-to-play elements rather than paid elements.
 MAJOR: The first regular event, Ranked Challenge will be available to play in this version. More information about this will be available at a later date, but players will compete to earn the most Ranked Points during the time period to win prizes!
 MAJOR: Added 10 Steam Achievements to the game. Stay tuned for more!
 Hovering over a card will now display the card on the left of the screen. You can still click/double-click cards to preview them even bigger.
 The intention is to work with artists in the future to allow them to create artwork for the store with a very high pay-out percentage.
 You can now view the history of past matches from the frontend. Future iterations plan to allow viewing in-detail turn data for each match.
 Added support for collecting in-game telemetry. This is data about games (match data & deck data) and rewards claimed. This data is used to inform game design decisions.
 Empty Character & Leader slots now have a graphic to indicate their position on the board
 The game board has been returned to the table. This makes the board state easier to understand. The forest level may return in the future.
 Finished art has been implemented for Penguin Slider from Ghibleaf, Tinkerer from Cyanlafurra, and Labardor from Cyobirdy.
 Added a refresh button to the Products menu (where you open booster packs)
 Further audio has been added to the game (both music and general SFX)
 Remaining mechanics for Labardor have been implemented, and the card is now playable.
 The frontend has been redesigned to look cleaner and more finished. Expect future iterations on this still.
 When claiming a reward through either the Rewards or Levels section, a widget pops up to confirm claiming the items and to redirect you to where you can see them
 Players must now make actions within a certain amount of time, otherwise their turn will be forfeit.


Bug fixes

 Fixed a bug where Cursed Lantern would lock bot players into a loop
 Fixed an issue where in some contexts, Character cards that have no faction would show up as having one (cosmetic only)
 Fixed a bug where Goose being in play would cause attacks to fail randomly
 Fixed a bug where bot players would have no Leader cards in their deck


Rebalances
Rebalances only happen under very specific circumstances. It is preferable to print cards in future expansions that answer issues with cards where possible.
Scroll of Premonitions
 Now provides +2 ATK to Arcana Characters (was +1)
Labardor
 DEF 6 -> DEF 5
 40 Gold cost -> 60 Gold cost
Sage
 Due to the introduction of CHR+ allowing you to have 5 Characters in play, Sage's effect now reads "You may shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, draw a card for each Character and Leader card you have in play."

notes.title: Upcoming Update Information (v0.6)
notes.notes:
It's been a little while since the last game update, so a lot of changes are going to be bundled into this next big update! Here's a sneak peek at some of the most important changes in the upcoming v0.6 build!
Note: As the game is still in a pre-release state, placeholder content in cards and UI artwork is still visible

https://i.imgur.com/AwLIake.jpeg

Stat Modifiers
When your thoughts on the "Chain Reveal" mechanic of Treasure cards were asked, your voice decided that while it was an interesting mechanic, it would be much better replaced by something simpler to understand and utilise.

Stat Modifiers are that mechanic! Chain Revealing is a thing of the past, and now each Treasure card you have face-up will allow you to boost one of four stats:

ATK+: Grants 1 extra Attack during Combat
DEF+: Grants 1 extra Defense during Combat
CHR+: Allows you to put 1 more Character into play
RDY+: Allows you to Ready one more card at the beginning of your turn


https://i.imgur.com/S9IS5MN.png

Stat Modifiers for each player can be found in the left-hand corners of the screen next to a player's profile. Some minor rebalancing has been done to cards as a result of this major change.
https://i.imgur.com/FVOpTul.png

Events
Regular events are to be trialled in the game to create a 'hotspot' period of the week where more players are online & active, while rewarding players handsomely for their participation!

Ranked Challenge is the first such event. During the weekend (Saturday morning through Monday morning), players will be challenged to earn as many Ranked Points from participating in games (including games against real users and bots if matchmaking is empty), and the players who earn the most Ranked Points will be rewarded with great Ranked Challenge exclusive prizes!

https://i.imgur.com/WZ2NHja.jpeg
(displayed users were randomly selected for display purposes)

Rewards Pass
Allowing players to earn as much content as possible through gameplay is important to the design values of AT:TCG. The Rewards Pass allows players more opportunities to earn more prizes, offering a unique selection of Challenges to complete for special prizes, and greater rewards for levelling up through natural gameplay!

Initially, the Rewards Pass will only be available as a high-level reward in the game, but the intention is to have this be primarily a paid item once the mechanic is solidified, it has received final art, and once it has been determined to be of sufficient value for players. Rewards Passes will always be available through reasonable natural gameplay, and a new one would be distributed alongside new major release expansion packs.
https://i.imgur.com/mQPnLm6.jpeg
